title: SpendEntry
description:
A committed spend (SPEC §5.3). Written only after a paid response is confirmed.

The rolling hourly budget is the sum of committed entries plus active reservations within [now - 3600000 ms, now]. Entries older than the window are pruned and stop counting; they are not retained for reporting, because ADR-007 keeps the ledger process-local and bounded.

When settlement succeeded but the resource response was unusable, the entry stays committed and ResourceDeliveryError is raised with paid=true — the money moved regardless of what came back.

settlementId.description: Merchant/facilitator settlement identifier from PAYMENT-RESPONSE, when one was supplied. Absent when the pinned protocol marks the response optional and none arrived — that case commits with a diagnostic warning rather than failing (SPEC §6.7).

reservationId.description: The reservation this entry settles. Retained so that commit is idempotent: replaying a commit for an already-committed reservation MUST NOT double-count against the hourly cap.
